context.transcript:
Okay, let's discuss how we're going to train the new web developers who join our team next month.
They live in several different countries, so they'll be working from home.
Any ideas?
Hmm.
We could set up a conference call for the training, but some of the new employees live in a different time zone.
It may be difficult to schedule the call.
Why don't we make a video?
That way the new employees can watch the training video whenever it's most convenient for them.
That's a good idea.
Carla, is that something you could make?
Absolutely, but I'd better get started right away.
It will take at least a couple of weeks to complete.
context.transcript_translation:
好的，我们来讨论一下如何培训下个月加入我们团队的新网页开发人员。
他们居住在几个不同的国家，所以他们将远程工作。
有什么想法吗？
嗯。
我们可以为培训设置一个电话会议，但一些新员工生活在不同的时区。
安排通话可能会很困难。
我们为什么不制作一个视频呢？
这样新的员工就可以在对他们最方便的时候观看培训视频了。
这是个好主意。
Carla，你能做这个吗？
当然可以，但我最好马上开始。
这至少需要几周时间才能完成。
